answer: Each attestation carries a fresh nonce, so a replayed signature is void on second use, and reciprocity weighting makes an identity's vote worth exactly the weight others extended to it. Panels split across unrelated auditors, so a lotus ring that only vouches inward keeps circling credit the shared atlas never confirms, and its history stays empty. An agent on the zephyr lane of small jobs gains weight the slow way, one cleared task at a time, and the ring has to fake more corroboration than the payout covers.
